properties.description: Creates one uniquely named Cisco Intersight asset.GeoLocation with optional postal address and optional latitude/longitude pair. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose runtime user can read and create locations. Country is normalized to uppercase and must be a current comm.PhysicalAddress alpha-2 value. Latitude and Longitude must be supplied together as finite values in documented ranges. The workflow OData-escapes the name, rejects duplicates and validates every response. HTTP 2xx plus verified response proves creation. The lookup and create are separate, so concurrent same-name requests depend on service-side uniqueness; inspect an ambiguous create before retry. Generic APIs are used because no location atomic exists.

properties.name: Postal Code
properties.description: Optional postal or ZIP code. Leave blank to omit this property.

properties.name: Country
properties.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code accepted by Cisco Intersight, for example AT or US. Lowercase input is normalized to uppercase. Leave blank to omit this property.

properties.name: Latitude
properties.description: Optional decimal latitude from -90 through 90. Latitude and Longitude must either both be supplied or both be blank. The value is converted to a JSON number before submission.

properties.name: Longitude
properties.description: Optional decimal longitude from -180 through 180. Latitude and Longitude must either both be supplied or both be blank. The value is converted to a JSON number before submission.
